config.aggregation: primary Spearman and balanced accuracy use A/B mean for each of 84 pairs; MSE advantage averages both directions per pair; macro-band MSE advantage averages 42 split-pair observations
config.block_transform: five contiguous two-time blocks; raw ppm; StandardScaler per 60-D block, PCA full SVD 2-D; fit all 168x8 DESIGN observations; global DESIGN z-coordinate StandardScaler after concatenation
config.bootstrap_ci: percentile 2.5%,97.5%; lower bound must be strictly >0
config.bootstrap_unit: 84 disjoint source pairs; both A/B directions remain clustered within sampled pair
config.gate_G0_1: at least 9/84 positive and at least 9/84 negative A/B-mean utilities (ceil 10%)
config.gate_G0_2: pooled Spearman >0, pair bootstrap CI lower >0, and each split Spearman >0
config.gate_G0_3: mean paired squared-error advantage INNER_CV minus GEOMETRY >0 and pair bootstrap CI lower >0
config.gate_G0_4: GEOMETRY pair-mean benefit-sign balanced accuracy >=0.60 and >=INNER_CV
config.gate_G0_5: MSE advantage positive in at least 3 of 4 macro-bands
config.gate_precedence: G0-1 false => HOLD; otherwise any G0-2..G0-5 false => STOP; all true => PASS
config.geometry: seven DESIGN-only descriptors for base and interaction plus interaction-minus-base: center norm, sqrt(trace pooled within covariance), participation ratio, task-noise alignment, absolute leading within-axis dot, d/(2K)*traceW/(sep2+traceW), sep2/(traceW+1e-12)-PR/(2K); pooled within covariance uses ddof=1 per class; signed log1p of all 21 values
config.geometry_predictor: Ridge with intercept; feature StandardScaler on 3 training bands; alpha selected by 3-fold leave-one-training-band-out mean MSE; ties smallest alpha
config.inner_cv: within-pair first4/last4 and reverse, same globally selected C for each reader; Delta=base minus interaction DESIGN validation log loss
config.interaction: u=z/sqrt(1+z^2); concatenate 2x2 u_b outer u_c for all b<c in lexicographic order to 40-D; no additional scaling
config.ordinary_fit: for four scalar descriptors use same 3-band ridge protocol; INNER_CV is its direct DESIGN utility estimate
config.pairs: within each y-row adjacent x columns (1,2),(3,4),...,(23,24)
config.reader: LogisticRegression L2 lbfgs, fit_intercept True, class_weight None, max_iter 500, tol 1e-8; base and interaction independent global C
config.reader_C_selection: minimum mean pairwise 4/4-swap DESIGN log loss across 63 pairs in 3 non-held-out macro-bands; ties smallest C
config.source_grid: 24 x-columns i=1..24 by 7 y-rows j=12..18, panel index=(i-1)*7+(j-12)
